name: TrustDemoTrustDomain
title: Trust domains of the journeys (illustrative)
description: Illustrative GDHCN-style trust domains for the demo's journeys: the scope under which each certificate in J1 to J4.1 is signed and verified. Invented for the demo, modelled on the GDHCN Trust Domains of SMART Trust; not GDHCN trust domains.

concept.definition: Routine-immunization DVCs (HCERT) signed per dose by a birth clinic system and verified by a home clinic EHR (J1, J3).
Verifiable Health Links (HCERT) to a patient summary, created on the national portal and resolved at a point of care abroad (J4.0, J4.1). Its terms of use are TrustDemoVhlTermsOfUse.
